subject: Insurance
title: Family History's Hidden Cost
description: A short lesson to help you apply Family History's Hidden Cost.

hook.text: If your parent died of heart disease before 60, your premium goes up.

buildup.text: Applications ask about parents' and siblings' causes of death. Cancer, heart disease, and diabetes all raise red flags.

discovery.text: A family history of early death can push you from Preferred to Standard rates—a 30-40% premium increase.

twist.text: Genetic testing is banned from underwriting in most countries.

climax.text: Your family tree has a price. Insurance charges for inherited risk even if you've never been sick a day in your life.

punchline.text: Parents' health, your premium. Genetics set insurance prices indirectly.

quiz.question: How does family medical history affect life insurance?
